caption:
This question mark doesn't belong here.

"The coach wondered whether the field would dry" reports a question but doesn't ask one, so it ends with a period.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: Reported questions end with a period, not a question mark.

youtube.title: SAT Punctuation: When NOT to Use a Question Mark
youtube.description: Indirect questions, like "She asked whether it would rain," end with a period. Only direct questions get a question mark.
